abstract: A 58-year-old woman was found to have metastatic thyroid cancer in her liver. This was identified when she was investigated for upper abdominal pain and underwent biopsy of hepatic lesions. She had no palpable thyroid nodule and had a normal ultrasound of the thyroid. Previously, both ovaries had been removed because of tumors. The pathologic findings in one of the ovaries could not be recovered because the procedure was more than 40 years ago, when the patient was a teenager. By a process of elimination, a diagnosis of metastatic struma ovarii was established. Treatment of metastatic thyroid cancer from struma ovarii, including removal of the normal thyroid and administration of I-131, is presented.
abstract_ja: 58歳女性が肝転移を伴う甲状腺癌と診断された。上腹部の腹痛の精査中に肝病変の生検が行われた。触知可能な甲状腺結節はなく、甲状腺の超音波検査は正常であった。以前に両側の卵巣に腫瘍が認められ摘出されていたが、患者が10代であった40年以上前の手術のため、一方の卵巣の病理所見は回収できなかった。除外診断により、転移性卵巣甲状腺腫と診断された。正常甲状腺の全摘と、I-131投与を含む転移性甲状腺癌の治療について述べる。
